name: todo
stack: .NET 9, ASP.NET Core Razor Pages, EF Core + SQLite, xUnit, Playwright (TypeScript)

test_list: dotnet test --nologo --list-tests | sed -n '/The following Tests are available:/,$p' | tail -n +2 | sed 's/^ *//'
cd e2e && npx playwright test --list --reporter=list | grep -E '›' | sed 's/^ *//'

staging.up: docker compose -p todo-staging -f deploy/compose.yml --env-file deploy/staging.env up -d --remove-orphans

prod.up: docker compose -p todo-prod -f deploy/compose.yml --env-file deploy/prod.env up -d --remove-orphans
